notes: North-up sheet, tilted slightly (McMillan and Fleming slope down to the right ~0.025-0.045). Printed names: E. McMILLAN, S. ELM, ALMS PL., ASHLAND AV. (both parts), HIGHLAND AV. (IN EAST WALNUT HILLS), FLEMING, CYPRESS; 'Street' added to the suffixless McMillan, Fleming and Cypress. Ashland jogs at McMillan: the north part (sheet 320) is ~500 px (~80 ft) east of the south part, so two T points. The 25 ft street from Ashland to Highland at the bottom carries no name on this sheet or on sheet 329; the key map draws it as the continuation of Cypress, so it is named 'Cypress Street (east of Ashland)'. Ashland and Highland both slant (~-0.06 dx/dy) and their slant steepens slightly south of Fleming (~40 px over 3,800 px); treated as straight, no bends recorded. The irregular line in block 1 between Elm and Ashland is a lot line, not a street. Points within ~15 px.
